title: Nifty SIP return fails to beat even bank FD over 5 years: Is this the warning sign investors can’t ignore?
summary: New insights reveal that systematic investment plans in the Nifty50 have consistently underperformed, presenting a five-year XIRR of merely 4.5%. This result places Nifty50 below the returns of traditional fixed deposits. In contrast, midcap and smallcap indices have shown impressive gains. Analysts recommend a strategy focusing on individual stock selection and earnings growth rather than relying solely on index performance, prompting a reassessment of index-based investment approaches.

title: 15-year setback on cards? Nifty heading for worst annual performance since 2011
summary: As 2023 unfolds, the Nifty index appears headed for its most disappointing year in a decade and a half. Key contributors to this downturn include high valuations and a flight of foreign investors. The IT sector continues to struggle amid geopolitical conflicts that have exacerbated oil prices and inflation fears. While local institutions lend some assistance, international investors remain reluctant.

title: Coforge shares rise 2% after firm appoints Akhil Kumar Gupta as chairman post OP Bhatt’s abrupt resignation

title: Sun Pharma, Aurobindo Pharma, other stocks in focus as Trump exempts India from 100% tariffs on some speciality drugs
summary: Indian pharma stocks, including Sun Pharma and Aurobindo Pharma, are in focus after the US exempted India and 19 other countries from 100% tariffs on certain patented specialty pharmaceuticals and ingredients. Eligible products include rare-disease drugs, gene and cell therapies, and infertility treatments. Generic medicines remain outside the Section 232 tariffs.

title: BSE set to enter Nifty 50 from tomorrow, IT major Wipro to exit. What shareholders must know?

title: SIPs offer steady gains as most fund categories beat benchmark indices
